question: India's 'Statue of Unity' is situated in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

__
 
• India's 'Statue of Unity' is situated in the state of **Gujarat.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Statue of Unity in India is the world’s tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

 
 
• Located at Narmada Valley Kevadiya colony, Gujarat.
 
• Designed by Indian sculptor Ram V. Sutar.
 
• Height : 182 metres (597 feet)
 
• Constructed by Larsen & Toubro.
 
• Constructed on a river island named Sadhu Bet.
 
• Inaugurated on 31 October 2018.
 
• Inaugurated by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
